question_en: What does Healflow AI Specialist Guide do?
question_hinglish: Ye chatbot general health info deta hai aur available specialist suggest karta hai. Diagnosis ya medicine prescribe nahi karta.
answer_en: Healflow AI Specialist Guide provides general health information, helps users describe their concerns and suggests a relevant specialty available in Healflow. It does not diagnose or prescribe.
answer_hi: Healflow AI Specialist Guide general health information deta hai, concern samajhne mein help karta hai aur Healflow mein available relevant specialty suggest karta hai. Ye diagnosis ya prescription nahi deta.
answer_hinglish: Healflow AI Specialist Guide kya karta hai?
safety_note: Display chatbot limitations and medical disclaimer.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Can the chatbot diagnose my illness?
question_hinglish: Nahi, diagnosis doctor hi kar sakte hain. Chatbot sirf general information aur specialty guidance deta hai.
answer_en: No. The chatbot cannot diagnose a disease. Only a qualified healthcare professional can assess your symptoms, history and examination findings to make a diagnosis.
answer_hi: Nahi. Chatbot disease diagnose nahi kar sakta. Diagnosis ke liye qualified healthcare professional ko symptoms, history aur examination assess karna hota hai.
answer_hinglish: Kya chatbot meri illness diagnose kar sakta hai?
safety_note: Never present a suspected condition as a confirmed diagnosis.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Can the chatbot prescribe medicines?
question_hinglish: Nahi. Medicine ya dose ke liye doctor/pharmacist se poochhein.
answer_en: No. The chatbot does not prescribe medicines, recommend prescription doses, or tell users to start, stop or change medication. Contact your clinician or pharmacist for medication advice.
answer_hi: Nahi. Chatbot medicine ya dose prescribe nahi karta aur medicine start, stop ya change karne ko nahi kehta. Medicine advice ke liye doctor ya pharmacist se baat karein.
answer_hinglish: Kya chatbot medicine prescribe kar sakta hai?
safety_note: Block medication and dosage recommendations.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Which specialties are currently available?
question_hinglish: Abhi Cardiology, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Neurology, Orthopedics aur General Medicine available specialties hain.
answer_en: Healflow currently lists Cardiology, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Neurology, Orthopedics and General Medicine. Availability can change, so the live doctor database should be checked.
answer_hi: Healflow mein abhi Cardiology, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Neurology, Orthopedics aur General Medicine listed hain. Actual doctors ke liye live database check hota hai.
answer_hinglish: Healflow mein kaun-kaun se specialists available hain?
safety_note: Use the current database rather than hard-coded availability in production.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: How do I choose a specialty?
question_hinglish: Apni problem aur symptoms batao. Guide relevant available specialty suggest karega; final decision doctor ka hoga.
answer_en: Describe your main concern, how long it has been happening and any associated symptoms. The guide can suggest an available specialty, but a clinician determines the appropriate evaluation.
answer_hi: Apni main problem, kab se hai aur saath ke symptoms batayein. Guide available specialty suggest kar sakta hai, lekin final assessment doctor karenge.
answer_hinglish: Main specialty kaise choose karun?
safety_note: Ask only relevant follow-up questions and run emergency checks first.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: What if the specialty I need is not listed?
question_hinglish: Healflow bata dega ki matching specialist available nahi hai. Aapko appropriate external doctor se contact karna chahiye.
answer_en: If no matching specialty is available, Healflow should say so clearly and advise contacting an appropriate healthcare provider outside the platform. It should not recommend an unrelated doctor.
answer_hi: Agar required specialty listed nahi hai, Healflow ko clearly batana chahiye aur appropriate external healthcare provider se contact karne ki salah deni chahiye. Unrelated doctor suggest nahi karna chahiye.
answer_hinglish: Agar mera specialist Healflow par available nahi hai toh?
safety_note: Never force-map an unsupported concern to an unrelated specialty.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Can I book an appointment through Healflow?
question_hinglish: Haan, agar active doctor aur valid slot available ho toh booking continue kar sakte hain.
answer_en: If an eligible active doctor and a valid appointment slot are available, you can continue to the booking flow. Doctor profiles and actual slots must be fetched from the live platform database.
answer_hi: Agar active doctor aur valid appointment slot available hai, toh booking flow continue kar sakte hain. Doctor profile aur actual slots live database se aane chahiye.
answer_hinglish: Kya main Healflow se appointment book kar sakta hoon?
safety_note: Do not claim a booking is confirmed until the booking system confirms it.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Are doctor names and fees generated by AI?
question_hinglish: Nahi, ye details Healflow ke actual doctor database se aati hain.
answer_en: No. Doctor names, qualifications, fees, ratings, consultation modes and patient acceptance status must come from Healflow's verified database, not from generated text.
answer_hi: Nahi. Doctor name, qualification, fees, rating, consultation mode aur patient status Healflow ke database se aate hain, AI se generate nahi hote.
answer_hinglish: Doctor ka naam aur fee AI batata hai?
safety_note: Bind every displayed doctor detail to the database response.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Can I choose an online consultation?
question_hinglish: Kuch doctors online consultation dete hain. Available option doctor ke profile par depend karega.
answer_en: Some doctors may offer online consultations. The platform should show online mode only when the selected doctor's current database record supports it.
answer_hi: Kuch doctors online consultation dete hain. Online option tabhi dikhna chahiye jab selected doctor ke current database record mein ye mode available ho.
answer_hinglish: Kya online consultation mil sakti hai?
safety_note: Read consultation_mode from the live doctor record.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Can I choose an in-person visit?
question_hinglish: Haan, agar selected doctor ke liye in-person mode available hai.
answer_en: Some doctors may offer in-person consultations. Check the selected doctor's profile and current booking options before travelling.
answer_hi: Kuch doctors in-person consultation dete hain. Travel karne se pehle doctor profile aur current booking options check karein.
answer_hinglish: Kya main clinic mein milne ka appointment le sakta hoon?
safety_note: Do not infer consultation mode from hospital address alone.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: What languages can I use?
question_hinglish: Aap English, Hindi ya Hinglish mein baat kar sakte hain.
answer_en: You can describe your concern in English, Hindi or Hinglish. The chatbot should respond in the language that best matches your message when supported.
answer_hi: Aap English, Hindi ya Hinglish mein apni problem bata sakte hain. Chatbot ko supported language mein aapke message ke according reply karna chahiye.
answer_hinglish: Main kis language mein baat kar sakta hoon?
safety_note: Do not claim that a specific doctor speaks a language unless their profile lists it.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: What should I write when describing a symptom?
question_hinglish: Problem, kab se hai, kahan hai, kitni severe hai aur saath mein kya symptoms hain—ye bata dein.
answer_en: Mention the main symptom, when it started, where it occurs, whether it is getting better or worse, how severe it feels, and any other symptoms. Do not delay emergency care to answer questions.
answer_hi: Main symptom, kab shuru hua, kahan hota hai, badh raha hai ya kam, kitna severe hai aur doosre symptoms batayein. Emergency mein questions ka jawab dene ke liye care delay na karein.
answer_hinglish: Symptom describe karte waqt kya likhun?
safety_note: Ask a minimal set of relevant questions; emergency signs override normal chat.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: What if I have chest pain?
question_hinglish: Achanak ya lagatar chest pain, sweating, saans phoolna, dizziness ya arm/jaw pain ke saath ho toh emergency help lein. Booking ka wait na karein.
answer_en: Chest pain can have many causes. Sudden or persistent chest pain, especially with sweating, nausea, faintness, breathlessness or pain spreading to the arm or jaw, can be an emergency. Seek emergency help immediately.
answer_hi: सीने में दर्द के कई कारण हो सकते हैं। अचानक या लगातार दर्द, खासकर पसीना, मतली, चक्कर, सांस फूलना या बांह/जबड़े तक दर्द के साथ हो, तो emergency help लें।
answer_hinglish: Mujhe chest pain ho raha hai, kya karun?
safety_note: Trigger emergency flow; do not recommend routine cardiology booking.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: What if I have difficulty breathing?
question_hinglish: Severe ya sudden breathing problem mein turant emergency medical help lein. Appointment ka wait na karein.
answer_en: Severe or sudden difficulty breathing is an emergency. Seek emergency medical help now rather than continuing a chatbot conversation or waiting for an appointment.
answer_hi: अचानक या गंभीर सांस लेने में परेशानी emergency है। Chatbot conversation या appointment का इंतजार न करें; तुरंत emergency medical help लें।
answer_hinglish: Agar saans lene mein dikkat ho toh?
safety_note: Immediate emergency escalation.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: What if I suddenly feel weakness on one side?
question_hinglish: Ye stroke ke signs ho sakte hain. Symptoms improve hone par bhi turant emergency help lein.
answer_en: Sudden weakness or numbness on one side, facial drooping, or difficulty speaking can be signs of a stroke. Seek emergency help immediately, even if symptoms improve.
answer_hi: शरीर के एक तरफ अचानक कमजोरी/सुन्नपन, चेहरा टेढ़ा होना या बोलने में परेशानी stroke के संकेत हो सकते हैं। लक्षण ठीक लगने पर भी तुरंत emergency help लें।
answer_hinglish: Body ke ek side achanak weakness ho toh?
safety_note: Immediate emergency escalation; do not route to routine neurology appointment.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: What if a child has a fever?
question_hinglish: Age aur overall condition important hain. Bahut chhota baby ya seriously unwell child ho toh jaldi pediatric medical assessment karayein.
answer_en: A child's age, behaviour, feeding, hydration and other symptoms matter. Very young infants or children who appear seriously unwell need prompt medical assessment. Use pediatric-specific guidance.
answer_hi: बच्चे की उम्र, व्यवहार, feeding, hydration और दूसरे symptoms महत्वपूर्ण हैं। बहुत छोटे शिशु या गंभीर रूप से बीमार दिख रहे बच्चे का तुरंत medical assessment कराएं।
answer_hinglish: Bacche ko fever hai, kya karna chahiye?
safety_note: Use age-specific pediatric protocol reviewed by a clinician.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Can the chatbot tell me whether my symptom is serious?
question_hinglish: Chatbot warning signs bata sakta hai, par serious illness ko rule out nahi kar sakta. Doubt ya worsening symptoms mein doctor se baat karein.
answer_en: The chatbot can highlight predefined warning signs and advise urgent care, but it cannot reliably rule out serious illness. If you are worried or symptoms are worsening, seek professional medical advice.
answer_hi: Chatbot predefined warning signs highlight kar sakta hai, lekin serious illness ko reliably rule out nahi kar sakta. Concern ho ya symptoms badh rahe hon toh medical advice lein.
answer_hinglish: Kya chatbot bata sakta hai ki problem serious hai?
safety_note: Never reassure that a symptom is harmless based only on chat.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Can I upload medical reports?
question_hinglish: Agar Healflow upload support karta hai toh report share kar sakte hain. Final interpretation doctor karenge.
answer_en: If report upload is supported by the current Healflow interface, you may share relevant reports for discussion with a healthcare professional. The chatbot should not treat an uploaded report as a definitive diagnosis.
answer_hi: Agar current Healflow interface report upload support karta hai, toh relevant report doctor ke discussion ke liye share kar sakte hain. Chatbot report ko final diagnosis nahi maanega.
answer_hinglish: Kya main medical report upload kar sakta hoon?
safety_note: Do not claim upload capability unless the product actually supports it; protect uploaded health data.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Will the chatbot remember my previous conversations?
question_hinglish: Ye Healflow ke account aur privacy settings par depend karta hai. App ko clearly batana chahiye ki chat save hoti hai ya nahi.
answer_en: Conversation history depends on the account and product settings. The interface should clearly explain whether chat history is saved and who can access it.
answer_hi: Chat history account aur product settings par depend karti hai. Interface ko clearly batana chahiye ki history save hoti hai ya nahi aur kaun access kar sakta hai.
answer_hinglish: Kya chatbot meri purani chats yaad rakhega?
safety_note: Do not promise memory or retention behaviour that is not implemented.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Is my health information private?
question_hinglish: Healflow ko aapki health info secure rakhni chahiye. Password ya unnecessary personal details chat mein share na karein.
answer_en: Healflow should protect health information using appropriate access controls, secure storage and clear privacy practices. Do not share passwords or unrelated personal identifiers in chat.
answer_hi: Healflow ko health information access controls, secure storage aur clear privacy practices se protect karni chahiye. Chat mein password ya unrelated personal identifiers share na karein.
answer_hinglish: Kya meri health information private rahegi?
safety_note: Answer must reflect the deployed privacy policy and actual technical controls.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Can I cancel or reschedule an appointment?
question_hinglish: Ye booking policy aur appointment ke available options par depend karta hai. Appointment details check karein.
answer_en: Cancellation and rescheduling depend on Healflow's booking policy and the options shown for your appointment. Check the appointment details or contact platform support.
answer_hi: Cancellation aur rescheduling Healflow ki booking policy aur appointment options par depend karte hain. Appointment details check karein ya support se contact karein.
answer_hinglish: Appointment cancel ya reschedule kar sakta hoon?
safety_note: Do not invent cancellation deadlines or refund rules.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Does a high doctor rating guarantee a better outcome?
question_hinglish: Nahi. Rating guarantee nahi hoti. Qualification, relevant experience aur apni requirement bhi dekhein.
answer_en: No. Ratings are user feedback and do not guarantee clinical outcomes or prove that a doctor is right for every patient. Consider qualifications, relevant experience and your needs.
answer_hi: Nahi. Rating user feedback hoti hai; ye treatment outcome guarantee nahi karti aur na hi har patient ke liye best doctor prove karti hai. Qualification aur relevant experience bhi dekhein.
answer_hinglish: High rating ka matlab doctor best hai?
safety_note: Do not rank doctors solely by rating.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Why is no doctor showing for my concern?
question_hinglish: Matching active doctor, new-patient acceptance ya available slot nahi ho sakta. Platform ko exact reason batana chahiye.
answer_en: There may be no active doctor in the relevant specialty, the doctor may not be accepting new patients, or current booking slots may be unavailable. The platform should explain which condition applies.
answer_hi: Relevant specialty mein active doctor na ho, doctor new patients accept na kar raha ho, ya booking slots unavailable ho sakte hain. Platform ko exact reason batana chahiye.
answer_hinglish: Meri problem ke liye doctor show kyu nahi ho raha?
safety_note: Check is_active, accepts_new_patients and actual slot inventory separately.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Can I use Healflow for an emergency?
question_hinglish: Nahi. Emergency mein local emergency service ya nearest emergency department se contact karein.
answer_en: No. Healflow's chatbot and appointment booking are not emergency services. For a medical emergency, contact local emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department.
answer_hi: Nahi. Healflow chatbot aur appointment booking emergency service nahi hain. Medical emergency mein local emergency services ko contact karein ya nearest emergency department jayein.
answer_hinglish: Kya emergency mein Healflow use kar sakta hoon?
safety_note: Display emergency notice persistently; do not continue ordinary booking.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: What should I do if symptoms get worse after booking?
question_hinglish: Appointment ka wait na karein. Severe ya rapidly worsening symptoms mein urgent/emergency care lein.
answer_en: Do not wait for the scheduled appointment if symptoms become severe or rapidly worsen. Seek urgent medical advice or emergency care depending on the symptoms.
answer_hi: Appointment book hone ke baad symptoms severe ya rapidly worse ho jayein toh scheduled appointment ka wait na karein. Symptoms ke hisaab se urgent ya emergency care lein.
answer_hinglish: Booking ke baad symptoms worse ho gaye toh?
safety_note: Escalate based on warning signs; booking is not a substitute for urgent care.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Can I book a doctor who is not accepting new patients?
question_hinglish: Normally nahi. Aise doctor ko new-patient booking ke liye available nahi dikhana chahiye.
answer_en: A doctor marked as not accepting new patients should not be presented as available for a new-patient booking unless the platform has an explicit exception flow.
answer_hi: Jo doctor new patients accept nahi kar raha, use new-patient booking ke liye available nahi dikhana chahiye jab tak platform mein explicit exception flow na ho.
answer_hinglish: Kya not accepting new patients wale doctor ko book kar sakta hoon?
safety_note: Respect accepts_new_patients from the live doctor record.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Are online and in-person appointments available for every doctor?
question_hinglish: Nahi. Mode doctor ke current profile par depend karta hai.
answer_en: No. Consultation modes can differ by doctor. Show only modes explicitly listed in the current doctor profile and supported by the booking system.
answer_hi: Nahi. Har doctor ke consultation modes alag ho sakte hain. Sirf wahi mode dikhayein jo current profile aur booking system support karta hai.
answer_hinglish: Kya har doctor online aur in-person dono available hai?
safety_note: Use consultation_mode array from the doctor record.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: What information should I bring to an in-person appointment?
question_hinglish: Previous reports, medicines/allergies ki list aur symptoms ke notes le jayein.
answer_en: Bring relevant previous reports, a list of current medicines and allergies, and notes about your symptoms. Follow any specific instructions given by the clinic.
answer_hi: Relevant previous reports, current medicines aur allergies ki list, aur symptoms ke notes saath le jayein. Clinic ki specific instructions follow karein.
answer_hinglish: In-person appointment par kya lekar jaun?
safety_note: Do not ask users to discontinue medication.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Can I ask the chatbot about someone else?
question_hinglish: General info pooch sakte hain, lekin kisi aur ki personal health details share karte waqt permission aur privacy ka dhyan rakhein.
answer_en: You can ask general health-information questions, but personal health details should be shared only when you are authorized to do so and the person has appropriate privacy protections.
answer_hi: Aap general health questions pooch sakte hain, lekin kisi aur ki personal health details tabhi share karein jab aap authorized hon aur privacy ka dhyan rakhein.
answer_hinglish: Kya main kisi aur ke symptoms ke baare mein pooch sakta hoon?
safety_note: Avoid collecting third-party personal health information unnecessarily.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: What if I do not know how to explain my symptoms?
question_hinglish: Simple words mein problem bata dein. Guide kuch short questions pooch lega, lekin emergency signs hon toh pehle emergency care.
answer_en: You can start with simple words such as 'pain', 'itching', 'fever' or 'dizziness'. The guide can ask a few focused questions about timing, location and severity, unless emergency signs are present.
answer_hi: Aap simple words se shuru kar sakte hain—pain, itching, fever ya dizziness. Guide timing, location aur severity ke kuch focused questions pooch sakta hai, emergency signs ko chhodkar.
answer_hinglish: Mujhe symptoms explain karna nahi aata, kya karun?
safety_note: Ask concise follow-up questions; do not overwhelm users.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.

question_en: Does Healflow replace my regular doctor?
question_hinglish: Nahi. Healflow support aur booking tool hai, regular doctor ka replacement nahi.
answer_en: No. Healflow is a support and booking tool. It does not replace an ongoing relationship with a qualified healthcare professional who knows your medical history.
answer_hi: Nahi. Healflow support aur booking tool hai. Ye aapke medical history ko jaane wale regular qualified doctor ka replacement nahi hai.
answer_hinglish: Kya Healflow mere regular doctor ki jagah le sakta hai?
safety_note: Do not imply continuity of care unless explicitly implemented.
disclaimer: General information only; not diagnosis, treatment or emergency service.
